lines: - "Hello? Anyone? This is Corpus representative Latrox Une. I'm lost, cornered by Infested, and my locator is... well, it's been eaten. I am in the direst need of assistance... help?"
- "Perhaps if you bait out the Prime Infested in the area - and kill it - you might then retrieve me! You can do that, right?"
- "With the larger fellow out of the way, maybe there's a chance for me yet. Salvation!"
- "You exterminated both the alpha specimen AND its mother? Most impressive! And unlikely. But impressive! Is the next step, by any chance, saving me?"
- "You must locate me. I was near a Purifier before I got chased off, I remember that much. Perhaps look around there? Try to pick up my trail?"
- "Oh perfect! Your signal is getting stronger, so you're getting closer to my position. Please keep at it!"
- "My stars. Those chimeric monstrosities were never provided the remotest chance of disrupting things. You're terrifying. Well, come, save me!"
- "I...errr... I think you maybe stumbled on some sort of nest, there's a LOT more infested showing up out there. Guard yourself, Tenno."
- "Goodness. You Tenno really are as scary as they say. Oh, I'm getting a positive fix on you, please keep going."
- "They... they barely breached your perimeter! You're almost to me, don't stop now!"
- "Oh! Oh! Ah. Those pack of monstrosities that were chasing me gave up around there. I'm sure they've all crawled off by now, should be perfectly safe..."
- "Well, if I'd had you around, I never would have gotten into this mess. Keep looking, Tenno, I think you're close."

path: Final Stage: Protect the Corpus Scientist
lines: - "You made it! Oh, I could kiss those scary metal feet of yours! One last favor: Please watch my back while I collect the last of my samples, I can't go back empty-handed after all of this."
- "...I repeat, this is Latrox Une, intrepid Corpus explorer and in something of a spot of truly terrifying bother. I really would very much appreciate some timely and violent assistance."
- "Is there anybody out there? Please let there be somebody out there..."
- "No! Bad monsters! Get away! Shoo! ...Will somebody PLEASE come and help me out of this jam? Back! Back!"
- "Tenno! You're close by! Can I...err beg a moment of your time?"
- "Someone's here! I'm saved! Wait... you are here to help?"
- "There you are! Oh, a sight for sore eyes. Look at you! Magnificent!"
- "Oh. I say. Hello there. Look, hate to bother, but I need to collect samples, and, frankly, I'm in a bit over my head. Orienteering. Organ landscapes. Monsters. Mainly the monsters."
- "Hello? Latrox Une. Our Entrati friends have, I suppose, 'requested' that I provide them samples of native... fauna. Not the kind of people one can really fail, if you catch my drift. Help?"
- "What a relief! I was expecting to get my head bitten off at any moment. While you're here, can you help me collect some samples? Just a few, and then we're gone, I swear."
- "There! That one dropped a sample! Grab it!"
- "That ugly one just coughed up what we're after, could you grab a sample for me?"
- "I swear if the Entrati weren't demanding samples... Ooh, there's one! Pick it up quick!"
- "Beautiful, now we just need a few more like it."
- "Lovely. Think we can get a few more?"
- "Perfect, now we need to grab some more samples, just to be sure."
- "That should do it, hand the samples over to me, please."
- "Marvelous. That should be enough to keep the Entrati happy, give them here."
- "That's more than enough. I'm in your debt, my gargantuan metal friend."
- "Fantastic. I'm starting the data upload; this always draws infested, so keep me safe, if you wouldn't mind?"
- "This is the part I hate. When I upload the data, the Infested will undoubtedly come sniffing about. Do not let them interfere!"
- "Here we go. Processing... Oh, I hate it here. Hate it. I would give anything to get off this forsaken rock."
- "I think that's a respectable amount, given the circumstances. We could have gathered more, I suppose, but frankly, our Entrati friends can go and suck egg sacs."
- "Upload complete. I couldn't manage the whole spread of samples, but screw it; I'm out of here."
- "How can a whole moon be so disgusting? That's enough samples for today, catch you on the flipside."
- "And that, my friend, is a clean sweep. All samples uploaded. I'm going to lie down."
- "Done and done. Every sample uploaded. Science and your Entrati friends owe you a debt. Huzzah!"
- "We are green across the board, all samples cleared. Remarkable."

path: During The Kuva Wytch, Uranus Proxima
lines: - "What fortune, I've been marooned here for ages with these infested. I'll gladly help crew this ship in exchange for some pressurized atmosphere."
- "Tenno? How unlikely to meet you again in an infested asteroid field of all places? May I be so bold as to offer my services?"
- "Let it be known, I have many stories to tell... if you have drink to share."
- "Did I ever tell you about the time I barely escaped a frisky brood mother on Deimos?"
- "Where are the crew quarters on this ship anyway? I haven't had shuteye in days."
- "Glad to be aboard. Where's the mess hall?"
- "My, my, they do not make them like this anymore, do they."
- "Intrepid explorer, Latrox Une, at your service."
- "Put a bow on it, it's done."
- "You must be lost. Let me show you the way out of here."
- "What a shot. Did you see that?"
- "I don't suppose we have a doctor on board?"
- "Oh... I do say, I feel twenty years younger."
- "My goodness, you are a miracle worker. You even fixed the kink in my back."
- "Oh no. Captain! We've lost a good one."
- "She won't take much more of this punishment."
